claims.statement: Czyste Powietrze beneficiaries currently submit payment applications and must provide specified closeout evidence; document defects can delay reimbursement and installer collection.
The family installer relationship provides replaceable access to observe a live closeout workflow with permission, but no right to beneficiary files is assumed.

commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Payment-contingent document QA spans installer invoices, beneficiary evidence and program forms; generic document storage does not own the closeout checklist.
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own service contracts with installers; installers and beneficiaries retain their underlying relationships.
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Family installer proof, then accountant, energy-auditor and installer referrals.

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Assumption: 600-1,500 PLN per installer via referrals.
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Per-case fee collected on submission or partly contingent on payment approval.
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 55-70% after reviewer labor and OCR.
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: One to three analyst hours per case after automation.
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Secure storage, GDPR documentation, professional liability and accounting estimated at 5,000 PLN monthly at scale.
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Per closeout pack, optionally with a monthly minimum.
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Document reviewer labor, OCR, storage and specialist escalation.

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Energy auditors and grant consultants may bundle closeout help; win on turnaround, standardized evidence and installer integrations.
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Installer or beneficiary pays for a compliant closeout pack to unlock or avoid delay of a subsidy payment.
commercial_mechanics.payer: Installer, beneficiary or grant operator depending contract
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Upcoming final payment application with incomplete evidence.
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Repeat purchase for each subsidized project; annual framework renewal for installers.

contrary_evidence: Beneficiaries can complete payment applications themselves.
Program changes can shrink volumes or make automation obsolete.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Existing informal family operating relationship for permissioned process observation; proposed case-processing contracts and data-processing agreements are unsigned.
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Acquire cases through independent auditors and publish a fixed-price direct beneficiary service using user-uploaded documents.
critical_control_point.current_owner: The installer and beneficiary currently control project evidence; NFOŚiGW/WFOŚiGW controls acceptance.
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own service contracts with installers; installers and beneficiaries retain their underlying relationships.
critical_control_point.duration: Ongoing family relationship without fixed term.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Voluntary family-installer workflow access, excluding unconsented beneficiary documents.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder would control the document-QA service and its installer contracts.
critical_control_point.renewal: Access by mutual consent; future framework contracts would specify renewal.
critical_control_point.subject: Czyste Powietrze project-closeout workflow

economics.acquisition_route: Manually QA ten permissioned packs, measure defects and turnaround, then productize reviewer checklists and installer intake.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 6,000 cases annually at 800 PLN yields 4.8M PLN revenue; at 18% owner earnings and a 5x service-software multiple, an 80% stake could exceed 5M PLN in years 6-9. Program volume and automation rate are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly initially; hire trained reviewers after 30 monthly cases.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Case revenue less direct reviewer, OCR and specialist costs; target 60%.
economics.payback: A customer pays 500-1,200 PLN to reduce delay risk on a materially larger subsidy or installer receivable.
economics.pricing: 500-1,200 PLN per pack or 3,000 PLN monthly minimum.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every subsidized project creates a new closeout event.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned defect taxonomy and reviewer playbooks shorten processing.
fingerprint.customer: Polish retrofit installers and Czyste Powietrze beneficiaries.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Installer or beneficiary pays when submitting a payment application.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A closeout deadline or returned evidence pack.

founder_fit: Family renewable business provides operating context
risks: Sensitive documents require strong security and processor controls.

structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: trained reviewers and energy certification partners

structure.critical_dependency: Reviewer accuracy and stable program rules

thesis: Acquire a repeatable position immediately before subsidy payment submission and charge per compliant closeout pack.
